seance: U02 – Mettre en relief (2) : phrases clivées et emphase
resume: Mettre l'accent sur un élément avec les phrases clivées (It is… that, What… is, All… is, The thing is), l'emphase avec do / does / did, et les adverbes d'insistance.

sections.contenu:
Pour isoler l'élément important (« c'est … qui / que ») : ***It is / was*** + élément + ***that / who*** + reste.
- *Tom broke the server.* → ***It was Tom who** broke the server.* (pas quelqu'un d'autre)
- → ***It was the server that** Tom broke.* (pas autre chose)
- → ***It was on Monday that** Tom broke the server.*

Très utile pour **corriger** : *It isn't the network that's slow, it's the database.*

***What*** + proposition + ***is / was*** + élément mis en relief :
- *I need a holiday.* → ***What I need is** a holiday.*
- *He lost his job.* → ***What happened was (that)** he lost his job.*
- action : ***What you should do is** call them back.* (do + base)

Variantes :
- ***All*** *I want is some peace.* (tout ce que je veux, c'est…)
- ***The thing / problem / point is (that)***… : *The problem is that nobody tested it.*
- ***The reason why*** *… is that…* · ***The place where*** *… is…*

sections.titre: Emphase avec do et les adverbes
sections.contenu:
- ***do / does / did*** à l'**affirmatif** (accentué à l'oral) pour insister ou contredire : *I **did** send the email!* (si, je l'ai bien envoyé) · *She **does** work hard.* · *Do sit down.* (invitation chaleureuse)
- adverbes d'intensité : *absolutely, utterly, totally* (avec adjectifs « extrêmes » : *absolutely exhausted*, pas ~~very exhausted~~), *by far* (*by far the best*), *far / much / a lot* + comparatif (*far more efficient*), *the very* (*the very first time*), *whatsoever* après une négation (*no doubt whatsoever*).

cartes.question: « C'est en 2020 que j'ai commencé à coder » :
choix: It was in 2020 that I started coding.
It is 2020 that I started coding.
This was in 2020 when I started coding.
It was in 2020 which I started coding.

cartes.recto: Mets en relief « the price » : « The price worries me, not the quality. »
cartes.verso: *It's the price that worries me, not the quality.*

cartes.question: « Ce dont j'ai besoin, c'est d'un bon café » :
choix: What I need is a good coffee.
That I need is a good coffee.
Which I need is a good coffee.
What I need it is a good coffee.

cartes.question: « Tout ce que tu dois faire, c'est redémarrer » :
choix: All you have to do is restart.
All what you have to do is restart.
Everything you have to do is to restarting.
All you have to do it's restart.

cartes.recto: Réécris en mettant en relief l'action : « You should talk to your manager. »
cartes.verso: *What you should do is talk to your manager.*

cartes.question: Ton collègue dit que tu n'as pas envoyé le rapport. Tu réponds :
choix: I did send it!
I sent did it!
I have did sent it!
I do sent it!
cartes.explication: Emphase : did + base, accentué à l'oral.

cartes.question: Laquelle est naturelle ?
choix: I'm absolutely exhausted.
I'm very exhausted.
I'm absolutely tired a lot.
I'm much exhausted.
